title: Approximate tangent planes of two locally finite sets agree almost everywhere on their overlap
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, W ⊆ ℝ^P open, and A, B ⊆ ℝ^P Borel with Hⁿ(A ∩ K) < ∞ and Hⁿ(B ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ W (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P: if x ∈ W, x ∈ A and x ∈ B, then for every linear subspace Q, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (W A B : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen W → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → μHE[n] (A ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)), x ∈ W → x ∈ A → x ∈ B → ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q
